android.desc:
Meet LifeCal: a live wallpaper that turns time into motivation.
See your progress every time you unlock your phone.

Track time your way with 4 display modes:
- Year Progress
- Daily Progress (hourly or minute-by-minute)
- Life Calendar
- Countdown mode with custom title and date range

Mood check-ins built in (Year mode):
- Daily reminder enabled by default at 10:00 PM (you can change or disable it anytime)
- Log mood with an optional note
- Tap mood dots to view saved notes
- Customize each mood color with a full color picker

Milestones that stay visible:
- Add custom milestones with labels and colors
- Milestones are available in Year and Daily modes

Powerful personalization:
- Solid color or photo background
- Image dim control + optional parallax motion
- Flexible grid controls: columns, dot size, spacing
- Dot shapes: circle, square, rounded square, diamond, hexagon
- Grid patterns: standard, honeycomb, diagonal, wave
- Full color picker across the app for precise styling
- Typography controls: font style, weight, slant, and text size
- Optional current-day glow and breathe animation

Useful daily context:
- Stats, date/time, and daily thoughts
- Reorder info blocks to match your preference

Private and lightweight:
- No account required
- Runs fully on-device

Install LifeCal and make every day count.

quotes.text: This isn’t like other life calendar wallpapers that need automation to keep updating. It works fully offline and lets you customize everything.
